name: process
text: Chips are built through repeated deposition, patterning, etching, and polishing. Metrology checks the result, helping engineers keep the next run on target.

name: problem
text: But measurements arrive late. After a process shift, wafers keep moving while models are still learning from older results. REFLEX targets that feedback gap.

name: mechanism
text: We combine a baseline, a drift filter, and a regime model. Each request retains its timestamp and original prediction. Expert weights update only when the matching measurement arrives.

name: demo
text: This is actual local inference on a public recorded stream, accelerated. Both models request every fifth sample and receive results five samples later. The ensemble updates causally, with no future labels. Its regime state is bounded.

name: result
text: On dataset one, large prediction errors fell eighteen point eight percent at the same measurement budget. This is prediction quality, not measured defect reduction.

name: comparison
text: Across four delayed conditions, average root mean square error improved one percent. Halving measurements did not pass overall.

name: value
text: A basic diode simulation extends the loop to design: ninety-seven percent less target mismatch than random search.

name: vision
text: Our vision: learn from every experiment to design better semiconductor devices.
